messages:
Sam: FYI Verdant Health sent over a SIG/CAIQ + custom vendor risk sheet. Need a short turnaround (end of week). Link: https://files.redwood.com/verdant/sig_vh_2026.zip

Sam: Sales needs a canonical sentence about embeddings persistence for the questionnaire. Can someone pick this up?

Noor: I can take this. @security-requests-bot please open ticket and tag privacy/legal.

security-requests-bot: Ticket created: RINF-2026-551. Priority: P2. Assignee: Noor. Due: 2026-04-03.

Noor: Quick Q to sales: will Verdant run the POC on Hosted or Dedicated? That affects storage/residency answers.

Sam: They'll start on Hosted for speed. Legal will ask about analytics retention. They want assurance "no embeddings kept in analytics or third-party telemetry."

Lena: Our standard Hosted stance: we do not persist raw embeddings to analytics or long-term stores. We collect non-content telemetry (latency, token counts) for ops. If they require customer-controlled persistence, Dedicated/Private is recommended.

Ivan: Draft wording to paste into questionnaire:

"Redwood processes requests and computes embeddings transiently in-memory for the request lifecycle. We do not persist raw embeddings to analytics platforms or long-term storage for Hosted customers. For use cases that require customer-managed, auditable storage of embeddings, please discuss Dedicated or Private deployment options."

Noor: Add legal caveat: "Except as required by law or per a mutually signed data retention agreement." Also add POC deletion policy: 30 days after inactivity or on customer request.

Sam: Good. Noor, can you run through the SIG controls and mark which controls this response maps to (privacy/data-retention control IDs) and upload the completed template here? ETA EOD tomorrow?

Noor: Yes. Ill validate control IDs and post final answers + attach the completed SIG file. Will flag anything needing a one-off addendum.

security-requests-bot: RINF-2026-551 updated: status=In Progress, watchers=[Sam,Noor,Lena,Ivan].
